chain.text: Deus potest facere quidquid fieri non includit contradictionem. Tractatus de Principiis Theologiae is the systematic summary, attributed or strongly Occamist.

Pluralitas non est ponenda sine necessitate. Frustra fit per plura quod potest fieri per pauciora. Entia non sunt multiplicanda praeter necessitatem is later, Punch around 1639, not Ockham's own sentence.
The razor is a heuristic, not a proof of truth. A verified decomposition is not a Clay proof. Goldbach is not a Millennium problem. RH stays open.

decision.why: Source note and Q-Hebel quote the same razor. Scope limit is part of the chain.
